scope: Visual replacement of all eight gimmick prefabs, plus pipe segment and porcelain shard. Gameplay code and collider dimensions unchanged.
reference: Existing Box_Rocket_Square prefabs: rounded edges, inset panels, stylized highlights and readable silhouette.
shading: Vertex-colored enamel, baked short-range vertex ambient occlusion, soft specular highlight, heat tint/emission and URP shadow/depth passes. No numeric durability labels.
authoring: Edit each named Blender collection in local Unity Y-up coordinates or edit Unity prefab visuals. Existing per-piece, furnace-heat, active/inactive and panel bindings are retained. Build is an explicit authoring operation, never called at runtime.
regeneration: Run Blender in background with --python tools/art/build_gimmick_models.py -- <project>/TestResults/GimmickArt
BuildAndCapture replaces authored art in the ten scoped prefabs; do not run it over independent hand edits without preserving them.

validation.environment: Isolated worktree at a14d080 plus final art sources and assets; matching files copied to primary workspace.

performance: One combined vertex-colored mesh per animated/stateful part; shared material and reusable mesh assets, 16-bit indices. On-device performance has not been benchmarked.
